EmailTemplate.subject: ASU Graduate application update
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Contact.FirstName},
Congratulations, again! Thank you for your time today. Here is the information we discussed.
Your Next Steps
Log in to My ASU using your ASURITE ID and password. Please contact our University Technology Office at 480-965-6500 should you experience any difficulty.
Review your Priority Tasks on My ASU. You will need to complete anything in red, such as
submitting documentation of your completed MMR vaccinations reviewing your Financing Tasks under the Finances heading
All future communications will be sent to your asu.edu email address. Please set your primary email alias as firstname.lastname@asu.edu. If you need help with this, the technology office is available to assist with this as well.
Again, welcome to the College of Health Solutions family! It has been a pleasure connecting with you throughout the application process, and I hope you will contact me with any questions or concerns. Go Devils!
